purpose: Document the exact deterministic vesting formula used by VestingContract. No numeric estimates of V appear in this document — V is always expressed as the output of the formula applied to the actual revokedAt timestamp from the on-chain transaction.

contract_formula.effective_time: _effectiveTime(g, queryTime): if g.revoked && queryTime > g.revokedAt → return g.revokedAt, else return queryTime
contract_formula.effective_time_boundary: STRICT > (not >=). When queryTime == revokedAt, the cap does NOT apply.
contract_formula.linear_formula: floor(total * elapsed / duration) where elapsed = effectiveTime - start

determinism_proof.revokedAt_is_block_timestamp_of_revoke_t: revokedAt = uint64(block.timestamp) set by revokeGrant() at execution time. This value is recorded in the GrantRevoked event and in g.revokedAt storage.
determinism_proof.formula_is_deterministic_once_revokedAt_: V = floor(1000 * (revokedAt - 1759547342) / 31536000). Given revokedAt from the on-chain event, V is uniquely determined. EVM integer division is deterministic.
determinism_proof.later_block_vestedAmount_equals_V: For any later block with timestamp T_later > revokedAt: _effectiveTime returns revokedAt (cap applies since T_later > revokedAt strictly). vestedAmount = floor(1000 * (revokedAt - 1759547342) / 31536000) = V. Frozen at V.

active_window_proof.current_time_bound: Block 39709110 is well after cliff (1767323342) and before end (1791083342). Any MultiSend execution at current chain time will satisfy cliff <= revokedAt < end.
active_window_proof.consequence: 0 < V < 1000 is guaranteed at execution time

no_estimates: This artifact intentionally omits any numeric prediction of V. V is defined as floor(1000 * (revokedAt - 1759547342) / 31536000) where revokedAt is the block.timestamp of the MultiSend transaction. V will be read from the GrantRevoked event after execution and verified against this formula.
